maddeler.e:
نستهتر (form X)
# نَسْتَهْتِرُ (nastahtiru) /nas.tah.ti.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# نَسْتَهْتِرَ (nastahtira) /nas.tah.ti.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# نَسْتَهْتِرْ (nastahtir) /nas.tah.tir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
